rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for folding material, arranging it by folding, or becoming folded.

example.english: I’ll fold the clothes before going out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zip3 hou2 di1 saam1 sin1 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use 摺 as the all-purpose noun for a physical fold or folded layer, rather than specifically the crease mark.

example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 saam1 jau5 jat1 zip3

rows.note: Use 摺痕 when you mean the visible crease or line left in folded material.

example.english: This paper has a fold mark; how can I get rid of it?
example.traditional: 張紙有條摺痕，點樣先至整得走？
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi2 jau5 tiu4 zip3 han4 dim2 joeng6 sin1 zi3 zing2 dak1 zau2

rows.note: Use this for folding or crossing one's arms, as in a defiant posture.

example.english: They fold their arms, clearly showing they refuse to budge.
example.jyutping: keoi5 bou6 zyu6 soeng1 bei3 baai2 ming4 m4 fuk6

rows.note: Use this in recipes when gently folding one ingredient into another mixture.

example.english: Gently fold the meringue into the batter.
example.traditional: 將蛋白霜輕輕拌入麵糊。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 daan6 baak6 soeng1 hing1 hing1 bun6 jap6 min6 wu4

rows.note: Use 褶皺 specifically for a geological fold in rock strata.

example.english: The geologist says these rock strata have a fold.
example.traditional: 地質學家話呢啲岩層有褶皺。
example.jyutping: dei6 zat1 hok6 gaa1 waa6 nei1 di1 ngaam4 cang4 jau5 zaap3 zau3

rows.note: Use 羊欄 for an enclosure or pen for sheep and similar domestic animals.

example.english: There is a sheep fold on the farm, with several sheep inside.
example.traditional: 農場入面有個羊欄，入面養咗幾隻羊。
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 joeng4 laan4 jap6 min6 joeng5 zo2 gei2 zek3 joeng4

rows.note: Use this when penning animals in or confining them within an enclosure.

example.english: At night, they fold the sheep in.
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 nung4 fu1 wui5 hyun1 zyu6 di1 joeng4
